observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: HTC 黄昭颖称手机难再创新突破，资源转向 AI 眼镜 VIVE Eagle
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: 9 月 3 日，HTC 为 AI 智能眼镜 VIVE Eagle 新增圆框款式并升级软件功能，同时登陆欧洲、北美和澳大利亚市场。高级副总裁黄昭颖在采访中表示，智能手机已很难找到新的创新突破，U24 Pro 预计今年底逐步进入产品周期尾声，资源将转向 AI 眼镜；若未来出现新的突破技术仍可能重新评估手机业务。据报道，VIVE Eagle 自 2025 年推出后，该品类今年营收规模已超越智能手机。
observationAnalysis.author: IT之家（RSS）

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 为什么下一个令牌预测器是对 LLM 的错误思维模型
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: 作者认为下一个令牌预测器只是对 LLM 的零阶近似，机制形态正确但不完整。现代后训练中的 RLVR 让模型通过自己探索生成的新序列并获得奖励来学习，类似会穷尽探索的象棋引擎而非模仿大师棋谱的下一步预测器，因此 RLHF 和 RLVR 编码的内容早已超出对现有文本的预测。
observationAnalysis.author: Hacker News 热门（buzzing.cc 中文翻译）

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 美国加州 3 名登山者轻信 Gemini 路线建议被困沙斯塔山，报警获救
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: 据 TechRadar 报道，美国加州 3 名缺乏经验的登山者向 Gemini 咨询沙斯塔山路线，按其预计 8 小时登顶的建议出发，实际耗时约 16 小时才登顶。他们夜间下撤时偏离路线进入 Mud Creek Canyon，一人膝盖受伤，报警后次日早晨获救，事后承认过于依赖 AI 而未自行判断。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Amazon EC2 now supports specifying compatible instance types on AMIs
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Amazon EC2 now enables AMI owners to define which instance types are compatible with their AMIs. Owners can specify supported instance types, unsupported instance types, or both — and any launch attempt on a non-permitted instance type is automatically blocked. AMI owners now have a built-in way to prevent launches on instances that are not compatible with their AMIs. This reduces the risk of failed launches due to incompatible instance-AMI pairings. By default, an AMI can be launched on any instance type, so existing workflows remain unaffected until restrictions are explicitly applied. This feature is available in all AWS Regions at no additional cost. To learn more, please visit the documentation .
observationAnalysis.author: aws@amazon.com

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Amazon Aurora MySQL now supports multi-source replication and delayed replication
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Starting today, Amazon Aurora MySQL supports two new replication capabilities: multi-source replication and delayed replication. Multi-source replication lets a single Aurora MySQL cluster replicate from multiple source databases at the same time, making it easier to consolidate data from separate MySQL databases. This enables critical use-cases, such as merging shards or aggregating data from separate databases (e.g. regional or departmental instances) into a central location for operational workflows, such as reporting and backups. To learn more, please refer to the MySQL multi-source replication documentation . observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Web Search on Amazon Bedrock is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-West)
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: The Web Search built-in server-side tool on Amazon Bedrock is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-West), helping bring grounded web results to compliance-sensitive government and public-sector workloads. Web Search helps supported OpenAI GPT models ground responses with information from the web. Responses include citations to the sources the model used so users can trace each claim back to its web origin. This can be especially valuable whenever an answer depends on information that changes over time or is more recent than a model's training data, such as current events, recent releases or live pricing. observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Amazon Connect Customer expands automated performance evaluations to Malay
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Amazon Connect Customer now automates evaluations of human and AI agents in Malay using generative AI. Managers define custom evaluation criteria in natural language and receive AI-generated evaluations with justifications in their preferred language. observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio CI/CD adds notebook promotion and AI-assisted manifest generation
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio CI/CD expands its open-source deployment toolkit with two new capabilities: (1) an AI agent skill that automates manifest authoring, and (2) native notebook promotion across environments. Together, they help data teams go from project to production faster while maintaining best-practice defaults across stages. AI-assisted manifest generation. The new generate-bundle-manifest agent skill inspects a project's connections, storage, and workflows and produces a ready-to-use deployment manifest. It applies least-privilege IAM guidance, substitutes environment variables in place of hardcoded resource identifiers, and sets safe defaults such as opt-in catalog handling. Teams can import the skill into their own agents to standardize how they package and promote Sage

observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: AWS Marketplace now supports auto-renewals for private offers. This capability helps sellers and buyers maintain active software and service subscriptions without re-negotiation or re-purchasing at the end of the term. Negotiated pricing and contract terms carry forward automatically when buyers and sellers agree to renew. This helps reduce procurement overhead and prevent unintended lapses in subscriptions. When creating a private offer, sellers define the renewal terms and choose how pricing carries forward: renewal with no price change, renewal with a fixed price change, or a price change within a defined range. observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Amazon DocumentDB now supports direct major version upgrades to version 8.0
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) now supports in-place major version upgrades (MVU) directly from engine versions 3.6 and 4.0 to version 8.0. This upgrade capability removes the need for intermediate version upgrades and allows you to upgrade your version 3.6 or 4.0 clusters while preserving existing data, configurations, and cluster settings. Upgrading to version 8.0 provides access to the latest security patches, performance improvements, and new developer capabilities. Major version upgrades from DocumentDB 3.6 and 4.0 to 8.0 are available in all AWS regions where these versions are currently supported. To learn more about upgrading to Amazon DocumentDB 8.0, including detailed guidance on version differences and upgrade paths, visit the Amazon DocumentDB MVU documentation

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Amazon Redshift now supports Apache Iceberg v3 tables
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Amazon Redshift now supports reading from and writing to Apache Iceberg v3 tables in your data lake. Apache Iceberg is an open table format, and its v3 release adds several new features. With this launch, Amazon Redshift introduces support for default column values, row lineage, and deletion vectors. With default column values, you can define an initial value that Amazon Redshift applies when no value is provided, simplifying schema evolution as you add columns to existing tables. Row lineage exposes pseudo-columns that track each row's identity and last-updated sequence number, so you can build incremental pipelines and CDC (change data capture) workflows that process only modified rows. observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery introduces Recovery Plans for orchestrated application recovery
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (AWS DRS) now offers Recovery Plans, a capability that automates the sequential launch of multi-server applications during recovery and drills. Instead of launching servers one at a time and tracking dependencies manually, you define the recovery sequence once and run it with a single action when you need it. This addresses a common challenge for customers running applications made up of databases, application tiers, and supporting services that must come up in a specific order. Recovery Plans let you group servers into sequential steps with configurable wait times between them, so your application recovers predictably and consistently every time. You can run plans in a non-disruptive drill mode to validate your procedures, add approval steps where you want a

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Video generation models as world simulators
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We explore large-scale training of generative models on video data. Specifically, we train text-conditional diffusion models jointly on videos and images of variable durations, resolutions and aspect ratios. We leverage a transformer architecture that operates on spacetime patches of video and image latent codes. Our largest model, Sora, is capable of generating a minute of high fidelity video. Our results suggest that scaling video generation models is a promising path towards building general purpose simulators of the physical world.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Building an early warning system for LLM-aided biological threat creation
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’re developing a blueprint for evaluating the risk that a large language model (LLM) could aid someone in creating a biological threat. In an evaluation involving both biology experts and students, we found that GPT-4 provides at most a mild uplift in biological threat creation accuracy. While this uplift is not large enough to be conclusive, our finding is a starting point for continued research and community deliberation.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Improving mathematical reasoning with process supervision
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve trained a model to achieve a new state-of-the-art in mathematical problem solving by rewarding each correct step of reasoning (“process supervision”) instead of simply rewarding the correct final answer (“outcome supervision”). In addition to boosting performance relative to outcome supervision, process supervision also has an important alignment benefit: it directly trains the model to produce a chain-of-thought that is endorsed by humans.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Forecasting potential misuses of language models for disinformation campaigns and how to reduce risk
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: OpenAI researchers collaborated with Georgetown University’s Center for Security and Emerging Technology and the Stanford Internet Observatory to investigate how large language models might be misused for disinformation purposes. The collaboration included an October 2021 workshop bringing together 30 disinformation researchers, machine learning experts, and policy analysts, and culminated in a co-authored report building on more than a year of research. This report outlines the threats that language models pose to the information environment if used to augment disinformation campaigns and introduces a framework for analyzing potential mitigations. Read the full report here.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Learning to play Minecraft with Video PreTraining
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We trained a neural network to play Minecraft by Video PreTraining (VPT) on a massive unlabeled video dataset of human Minecraft play, while using only a small amount of labeled contractor data. With fine-tuning, our model can learn to craft diamond tools, a task that usually takes proficient humans over 20 minutes (24,000 actions). Our model uses the native human interface of keypresses and mouse movements, making it quite general, and represents a step towards general computer-using agents.

observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve contributed to a multi-stakeholder report by 58 co-authors at 30 organizations, including the Centre for the Future of Intelligence, Mila, Schwartz Reisman Institute for Technology and Society, Center for Advanced Study in the Behavioral Sciences, and Center for Security and Emerging Technologies. This report describes 10 mechanisms to improve the verifiability of claims made about AI systems. Developers can use these tools to provide evidence that AI systems are safe, secure, fair, or privacy-preserving. Users, policymakers, and civil society can use these tools to evaluate AI development processes.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Deep double descent
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We show that the double descent phenomenon occurs in CNNs, ResNets, and transformers: performance first improves, then gets worse, and then improves again with increasing model size, data size, or training time. This effect is often avoided through careful regularization. While this behavior appears to be fairly universal, we don’t yet fully understand why it happens, and view further study of this phenomenon as an important research direction.

observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: As the final model release of GPT-2’s staged release, we’re releasing the largest version (1.5B parameters) of GPT-2 along with code and model weights to facilitate detection of outputs of GPT-2 models. While there have been larger language models released since August, we’ve continued with our original staged release plan in order to provide the community with a test case of a full staged release process. We hope that this test case will be useful to developers of future powerful models, and we’re actively continuing the conversation with the AI community on responsible publication.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Solving Rubik’s Cube with a robot hand
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve trained a pair of neural networks to solve the Rubik’s Cube with a human-like robot hand. The neural networks are trained entirely in simulation, using the same reinforcement learning code as OpenAI Five paired with a new technique called Automatic Domain Randomization (ADR). The system can handle situations it never saw during training, such as being prodded by a stuffed giraffe. This shows that reinforcement learning isn’t just a tool for virtual tasks, but can solve physical-world problems requiring unprecedented dexterity.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Fine-tuning GPT-2 from human preferences
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve fine-tuned the 774M parameter GPT-2 language model using human feedback for various tasks, successfully matching the preferences of the external human labelers, though those preferences did not always match our own. Specifically, for summarization tasks the labelers preferred sentences copied wholesale from the input (we’d only asked them to ensure accuracy), so our models learned to copy. Summarization required 60k human labels; simpler tasks which continue text in various styles required only 5k. Our motivation is to move safety techniques closer to the general task of “machines talking to humans,” which we believe is key to extracting information about human values.

Summarization required 60k human labels; simpler tasks which continue text in various styles required only 5k. Our motivation is to move safety techniques closer to the general task of “machines talking to humans,” which we believe is key to extracting information about human values.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Emergent tool use from multi-agent interaction
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve observed agents discovering progressively more complex tool use while playing a simple game of hide-and-seek. Through training in our new simulated hide-and-seek environment, agents build a series of six distinct strategies and counterstrategies, some of which we did not know our environment supported. The self-supervised emergent complexity in this simple environment further suggests that multi-agent co-adaptation may one day produce extremely complex and intelligent behavior.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Testing robustness against unforeseen adversaries
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve developed a method to assess whether a neural network classifier can reliably defend against adversarial attacks not seen during training. Our method yields a new metric, UAR (Unforeseen Attack Robustness), which evaluates the robustness of a single model against an unanticipated attack, and highlights the need to measure performance across a more diverse range of unforeseen attacks.

observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’re releasing the 774 million parameter GPT-2 language model after the release of our small 124M model in February, staged release of our medium 355M model in May, and subsequent research with partners and the AI community into the model’s potential for misuse and societal benefit. We’re also releasing an open-source legal agreement to make it easier for organizations to initiate model-sharing partnerships with each other, and are publishing a technical report about our experience in coordinating with the wider AI research community on publication norms.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Why responsible AI development needs cooperation on safety
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve written a policy research paper identifying four strategies that can be used today to improve the likelihood of long-term industry cooperation on safety norms in AI: communicating risks and benefits, technical collaboration, increased transparency, and incentivizing standards. Our analysis shows that industry cooperation on safety will be instrumental in ensuring that AI systems are safe and beneficial, but competitive pressures could lead to a collective action problem, potentially causing AI companies to under-invest in safety. We hope these strategies will encourage greater cooperation on the safe development of AI and lead to better global outcomes of AI.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: MuseNet
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve created MuseNet, a deep neural network that can generate 4-minute musical compositions with 10 different instruments, and can combine styles from country to Mozart to the Beatles. MuseNet was not explicitly programmed with our understanding of music, but instead discovered patterns of harmony, rhythm, and style by learning to predict the next token in hundreds of thousands of MIDI files. MuseNet uses the same general-purpose unsupervised technology as GPT-2, a large-scale transformer model trained to predict the next token in a sequence, whether audio or text.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Implicit generation and generalization methods for energy-based models
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve made progress towards stable and scalable training of energy-based models (EBMs) resulting in better sample quality and generalization ability than existing models. Generation in EBMs spends more compute to continually refine its answers and doing so can generate samples competitive with GANs at low temperatures, while also having mode coverage guarantees of likelihood-based models. We hope these findings stimulate further research into this promising class of models.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: AI safety needs social scientists
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve written a paper arguing that long-term AI safety research needs social scientists to ensure AI alignment algorithms succeed when actual humans are involved. Properly aligning advanced AI systems with human values requires resolving many uncertainties related to the psychology of human rationality, emotion, and biases. The aim of this paper is to spark further collaboration between machine learning and social science researchers, and we plan to hire social scientists to work on this full time at OpenAI.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: How AI training scales
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve discovered that the gradient noise scale, a simple statistical metric, predicts the parallelizability of neural network training on a wide range of tasks. Since complex tasks tend to have noisier gradients, increasingly large batch sizes are likely to become useful in the future, removing one potential limit to further growth of AI systems. More broadly, these results show that neural network training need not be considered a mysterious art, but can be rigorized and systematized.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Quantifying generalization in reinforcement learning
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’re releasing CoinRun, a training environment which provides a metric for an agent’s ability to transfer its experience to novel situations and has already helped clarify a longstanding puzzle in reinforcement learning. CoinRun strikes a desirable balance in complexity: the environment is simpler than traditional platformer games like Sonic the Hedgehog but still poses a worthy generalization challenge for state of the art algorithms.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Learning concepts with energy functions
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve developed an energy-based model that can quickly learn to identify and generate instances of concepts, such as near, above, between, closest, and furthest, expressed as sets of 2d points. Our model learns these concepts after only five demonstrations. We also show cross-domain transfer: we use concepts learned in a 2d particle environment to solve tasks on a 3-dimensional physics-based robot.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Learning complex goals with iterated amplification
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’re proposing an AI safety technique called iterated amplification that lets us specify complicated behaviors and goals that are beyond human scale, by demonstrating how to decompose a task into simpler sub-tasks, rather than by providing labeled data or a reward function. Although this idea is in its very early stages and we have only completed experiments on simple toy algorithmic domains, we’ve decided to present it in its preliminary state because we think it could prove to be a scalable approach to AI safety.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Glow: Better reversible generative models
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We introduce Glow, a reversible generative model which uses invertible 1x1 convolutions. It extends previous work on reversible generative models and simplifies the architecture. Our model can generate realistic high resolution images, supports efficient sampling, and discovers features that can be used to manipulate attributes of data. We’re releasing code for the model and an online visualization tool so people can explore and build on these results.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Learning Montezuma’s Revenge from a single demonstration
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve trained an agent to achieve a high score of 74,500 on Montezuma’s Revenge from a single human demonstration, better than any previously published result. Our algorithm is simple: the agent plays a sequence of games starting from carefully chosen states from the demonstration, and learns from them by optimizing the game score using PPO, the same reinforcement learning algorithm that underpins OpenAI Five.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Improving language understanding with unsupervised learning
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve obtained state-of-the-art results on a suite of diverse language tasks with a scalable, task-agnostic system, which we’re also releasing. Our approach is a combination of two existing ideas: transformers and unsupervised pre-training. These results provide a convincing example that pairing supervised learning methods with unsupervised pre-training works very well; this is an idea that many have explored in the past, and we hope our result motivates further research into applying this idea on larger and more diverse datasets.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Evolved Policy Gradients
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’re releasing an experimental metalearning approach called Evolved Policy Gradients, a method that evolves the loss function of learning agents, which can enable fast training on novel tasks. Agents trained with EPG can succeed at basic tasks at test time that were outside their training regime, like learning to navigate to an object on a different side of the room from where it was placed during training.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Competitive self-play
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve found that self-play allows simulated AIs to discover physical skills like tackling, ducking, faking, kicking, catching, and diving for the ball, without explicitly designing an environment with these skills in mind. Self-play ensures that the environment is always the right difficulty for an AI to improve. Taken alongside our Dota 2 self-play results, we have increasing confidence that self-play will be a core part of powerful AI systems in the future.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: More on Dota 2
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Our Dota 2 result shows that self-play can catapult the performance of machine learning systems from far below human level to superhuman, given sufficient compute. In the span of a month, our system went from barely matching a high-ranked player to beating the top pros and has continued to improve since then. Supervised deep learning systems can only be as good as their training datasets, but in self-play systems, the available data improves automatically as the agent gets better.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Learning to cooperate, compete, and communicate
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Multiagent environments where agents compete for resources are stepping stones on the path to AGI. Multiagent environments have two useful properties: first, there is a natural curriculum—the difficulty of the environment is determined by the skill of your competitors (and if you’re competing against clones of yourself, the environment exactly matches your skill level). Second, a multiagent environment has no stable equilibrium: no matter how smart an agent is, there’s always pressure to get smarter. These environments have a very different feel from traditional environments, and it’ll take a lot more research before we become good at them.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Driving Developer Excellence: Inside the Program Sprints
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: The Gemini Enterprise Developer Experience (DevEx) program conducts ongoing sprint testing of end-to-end developer workflows to identify and rapidly resolve friction points without relying on internal shortcuts. observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Enterprise-Grade Precision for Long-Context Multimodal Embedding Inference on Cloud TPU
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Google Cloud has natively integrated TPU support into the vLLM serving engine, allowing developers to elastically scale high-demand embedding pipelines using Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE). To handle massive 15K+ token contexts for models like Qwen3-Embedding-8B, the engineering team implemented TPU-specific optimizations such as hardware-safe tensor alignment, JAX/XLA compilation pre-warming, and a hybrid StepPool architecture for chunked prefill management. These enhancements achieve near-perfect numerical parity with reference GPU baselines, and developers can immediately leverage the open-sourced setup recipes on the AI-Hypercomputer GitHub to build their own high-throughput semantic retrieval applications.

observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Moving live voice agents from demo to production requires rigorous, automated testing to handle the unpredictability of real multi-turn conversations. ADK now provides native live evaluation, allowing developers to test graph-based agent workflows against LLM-driven simulated users that generate actual audio via Gemini TTS. By defining evaluation scenarios and natural-language rubrics, you can automatically score audio responses and tool executions, inspect the resulting transcripts in ADK Web, or run the CLI directly in your CI/CD pipeline.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Build zero-trust AI agents with Google's Agent Development Kit
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Building autonomous AI agents that mutate production state requires moving beyond soft system prompts to a robust zero-trust architecture. To secure Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) workflows against prompt injections and malicious execution, developers must implement hardware-backed cryptographic signatures for database writes, kernel-level sandboxing with gVisor for dynamic code, and deterministic semantic gateways for I/O validation. By enforcing these hard security boundaries at the infrastructure level, you can safely deploy multi-tool AI agents without risking unauthorized data manipulation or server compromise.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: HeyGen x Google Cloud: Bringing Avatar IV to TPUs
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: HeyGen ported their 18B+ parameter Avatar IV video generation model to Google Cloud's Trillium (v6e) TPUs via torchax and XLA, utilizing FSDP and Ulysses sequence parallelism across an eight-chip mesh. To achieve a 1.86x speedup for real-time streaming, the engineering team pipelined exposed all-to-all collectives, aligned sparse attention block sizes to eliminate mask padding, and bypassed softmax serial dependencies using a precomputed Cauchy-Schwarz upper bound. These custom Pallas kernel and compiler optimizations were deployed only after passing rigorous two-tier quality gates to guarantee byte-identical or mathematically equivalent pixel outputs.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Introducing Credentio: Open Source C++ Library for C2PA Content Credentials from Google
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Credentio is a newly released, open-source C++ library from Google that allows developers to integrate high-performance, local-first validation of C2PA Content Credentials into their client and server applications. By processing assets entirely locally with a highly optimized memory footprint, the library delivers instant validation verdicts for multi-gigabyte media files without incurring cloud latency, bandwidth costs, or data privacy risks. The library currently features deep manifest parsing alongside configurable trust list integration, and is available now on Google Source with future plans to support full credential generation and embedding.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Why Go is an Ideal Language for AI-Assisted Software Engineering
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: As AI coding assistants shift the developer's primary role from writing boilerplate to reviewing and maintaining systems, language choice becomes critical for long-term architectural integrity. Go directly addresses this new paradigm by utilizing its strict compiler, integrated toolchain, and uncompromising readability to provide deterministic guardrails that help AI models self-correct and generate highly standardized code. By enforcing ecosystem-wide consistency and strict backward compatibility, the Go platform empowers engineering teams to efficiently verify, optimize, and maintain high-velocity, AI-generated output in production environments.

Google has officially joined as a Core Maintainer and already rolled out support in the Agents CLI and Data Agent Kit, allowing developers to start building and distributing interoperable plugins today.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Scaling AI Agent Infrastructure with the MCP Stateless updates
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: The 2026-07-28 Model Context Protocol (MCP) specification replaces legacy stateful constraints with a fully stateless core, enabling cloud-native horizontal scaling, serverless deployments, and standard round-robin load balancing. This architectural shift introduces standardized HTTP headers for efficient routing without deep packet inspection, caching controls, and Multi Round-Trip Requests (MRTR) to handle interactive and long-running tasks without blocking connections. Developers can immediately begin migrating their agentic applications to this highly scalable infrastructure using the newly available beta SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Go, and C#.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Model routing with Google Cloud API Gateway
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Google Cloud API Gateway now offers a model routing feature in Public Preview, allowing developers to dynamically route traffic to models like Gemini, Claude, or OpenAI OSS-GPT without hardcoding endpoints or managing open-source proxies. Developers can easily configure these routing rules directly within their OpenAPI 3.x specifications by mapping virtual model names to specific backend targets on a shared host. Once deployed, the Gateway acts as a serverless ingress layer that accepts standard OpenAI-compatible requests, automatically transcodes the payload to the native schema of the target model, and routes the traffic on the fly.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Scaling real-time AI agents with session-aware load balancing
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Real-time AI agents break traditional request-response load balancing paradigms because they rely on long-lived, stateful bidirectional streams that obscure true server capacity. To solve this, developers must implement application-level session tracking directly within the runtime to accurately measure the committed concurrent workload of active conversations. By feeding these precise session counts alongside standard CPU utilization metrics into a hybrid routing algorithm, infrastructure can effectively distribute stateful AI traffic and prevent individual backend bottlenecks.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Enable on-demand expertise with Agent Skills in Genkit Go
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: To prevent context window bloat and reduce token consumption, Genkit Go introduces Agent Skills based on a progressive disclosure architecture. Developers can package specialized instructions, scripts, and references into modular SKILL.md bundles where only the frontmatter metadata is initially exposed to the agent's system prompt. When a task matches the skill's description, Genkit's middleware dynamically loads the full instruction body and associated assets, ensuring the model accesses precise workflows exactly when needed.

Developers can package specialized instructions, scripts, and references into modular SKILL.md bundles where only the frontmatter metadata is initially exposed to the agent's system prompt. When a task matches the skill's description, Genkit's middleware dynamically loads the full instruction body and associated assets, ensuring the model accesses precise workflows exactly when needed.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Agent and Model Evaluations in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform are now GA
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Agent Platform's evaluation service is now generally available, providing developers with a unified engine to measure agent quality consistently across local development experiments and live production traffic. You can evaluate agents using over 20 pre-built metrics, DeepMind-backed adaptive rubrics, or custom code-based and LLM-as-a-judge metrics stored in a centralized, versioned registry. The service integrates directly into existing workflows via the Agent Platform SDK, agents-cli, and ADK, offering built-in user and environment simulators to automate complex multi-turn testing and streamline CI pipelines.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: How to use Google microbenchmarks for evaluating TPU performance
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Google's open-source TPU microbenchmark suite provides developers with granular performance metrics across Network, Compute, HBM, Host Transfer, and Attention components to validate real-world hardware capabilities. By leveraging these benchmarks to establish a Roofline model, engineers can accurately diagnose whether their machine learning workloads are compute-, memory-, or network-bound. This empirical baseline directly guides targeted software optimizations—such as kernel tuning, mesh sharding, and rematerialization—to maximize hardware utilization for large-scale model deployments.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Run Ray on TPU, Part 2: Ray AI libraries
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: This second installment explores how Ray’s higher-level libraries—Serve, Data, and Train—abstract the complexities of running AI workloads on Google's TPU slices. Ray Serve uses a simple topology configuration to correctly gang-schedule large multi-host models, while Ray Data eliminates data-loading bottlenecks by feeding accelerators directly with native JAX batches. Finally, JaxTrainer streamlines distributed training across TPUs by automatically handling cross-slice coordination, checkpointing, and fault tolerance.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Scaling Agentic RL: High-Throughput Agentic Training with Tunix
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Tunix is Google’s new JAX-native post-training library designed to eliminate TPU idling bottlenecks when training multi-turn, tool-using LLM reasoning agents. It maximizes hardware throughput by combining highly concurrent, asynchronous rollouts with a decoupled producer-consumer pipeline, ensuring the trainer is constantly fed even while agents wait on network I/O or environment steps. Additionally, Tunix provides plug-and-play abstractions and continuous macro-level profiling, allowing developers to easily integrate custom open-source environments and optimize complex distributed workflows without massive code rewrites.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Run Ray on TPU, Part 1: The foundations
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Ray 2.55 introduces official, first-class support for Google Cloud TPUs, enabling developers to run distributed Python workloads on Google's accelerators using the familiar Ray task-and-actor APIs. To handle the strict networking requirement of keeping multi-host TPU "slices" together over their Inter-Chip Interconnect (ICI), the KubeRay Operator on GKE automatically provisions and labels the underlying hardware layout. Ray Core utilizes these labels via its slice_placement_group() primitive to atomically reserve complete slices, allowing developers to deploy jobs through KubeRay, Ray Train, or Ray Serve simply by declaring a hardware topology (like "4x4") without writing custom placement code.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: GPT-6 Astra 模型发布，OpenAI 总裁布罗克曼自信放话“欢迎来到 AGI 时代”
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 5 日消息，据《商业内幕》报道，OpenAI 宣布，新推出的 Astra 模型已经达到 AI 行业最为追求的一个里程碑。当地时间周四，OpenAI 总裁格雷格 · 布罗克曼在宣布 Astra 模型推出的媒体电话会议结束时自信喊话：“ 欢迎来到 AGI 时代 。” OpenAI 将 AGI 定义为 在大多数具有经济价值的工作中，表现超过人类的高度自主系统 。在其看来，Astra 是一项重大研究突破，意味着人们能够交给 AI 完成的工作范围发生了变化。 布罗克曼此前认为，实现 AGI 并非一个突然发生的时刻， 而是一个渐进过程 。而这次在新模型发布后，他是这样说的：“未来人们回过头看，可能会认为 AGI 大概就是在这个时候出现的，我认为可能就是 从这个模型开始的 。就我个人而言，我确实认为我们已经到了这个阶段。” GPT-6 Astra 距离 GPT-5 模型系列推出约一年，距离 OpenAI 最近一次推出 GPT-5.6 升级约两个月。OpenAI 称 Astra 是“全球最智能、对齐程度最高的模型”，并将其形容为专业工作的一次跃迁。 根据介绍，Astra 可以填写表格、调整文档格式、安排预约以及操作软件。“任何你能在电脑上完成的事情，Astra 都能替你完成，而且速度很快。” 其他科技行业领导者同样将 AGI 视为 AI 发展的重要目标。据IT之家了解，谷歌 DeepMind 联合创始人哈萨比斯在 5 月举行的公司大会上作出预测： AGI 最早将在 2030 年出现 ，人类正站在“奇点的山脚下”。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 奇瑞风云 T11 第二次 OTA 推送：新增远程一键备车、高速 ETC 自主通行等
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 5 日消息，奇瑞旗下风云 T11 今日开启第二次 OTA 全域推送，带来 9 项全新功能、4 项深度优化。 IT之家整理如下： 新增猎鹰 700 紧急转向辅助功能 ：当你遇到突发情况猛打方向盘避让时，如果系统发现转向力不足，将智能增加转向辅助力，提升行车安全 (需在车机设置-智驾-主动安全界面-打开紧急转向辅助功能) 优化猎鹰 700 窄路通行能力：智驾模式下，车辆在狭窄路段的车道保持和避障表现更稳定从容 优化猎鹰 700 不规则障碍物及临时信号灯通行能力：智驾模式下，车辆避让将更高效、更精准 升级猎鹰 700 智驾底层模型：模型带来持续进化，扩充智驾使用场景，提升环境感知能力 全系 UI 交互优化：新增燃油里程显示、香氛动效、优化遮阳帘开关等细节，让你的座舱体验再升级 全系新增「智驾卡片」：当你每次用完智驾，车机屏幕上都会自动弹出智驾数据 (包含里程 / 时间 / 变道等)，清清楚楚一目了然。 新增远程一键备车功能 ：上车前用手机远程启动空调和座椅调节等，提前把座舱调到舒适状态，上车即走，无需等待。 全系新增「伯牙之音」智慧调音功能。以后车里坐几个人，音响就自动切换成最适合的声场模式 (需在设置-声音-音效调节-打开智慧调音功能) 新增儿童遗忘提醒功能：配合奇瑞商城专属儿童座椅 (蓝牙连接) 使用，下车时若检测到儿童遗留在车内，系统将立即提醒你，守护孩子的安全 新增儿童座椅异常提醒功能：配合奇瑞商城专属儿童座椅 (蓝牙连接) 使用，行驶中一旦检测到卡扣松动或安装异常，系统会及时提醒你，让孩子全程坐得更安心 新增猎鹰 700 窄路三点掉头功能：智驾状态下，遇到狭窄路段需要掉头，轻松应对窄路场景，无需手动反复调整 全系新增远程诊断功能：用车遇到疑问或故障提示，系统可远程实时检测车辆状态，帮你实时解决用车疑难 新增猎鹰 700 高速 ETC 自主通行功能 ：开

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 吉利星越 L PLUS 首发亮相：定位中大型旗舰智混 SUV，近期上市
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 5 日消息，吉利全新车型 —— 星越 L PLUS 今天（5 日）晚间正式亮相，新车尺寸比现款星越 L 更大，并运用双拼色、大饼轮毂来强调豪华、精致的气息，将于 近期正式上市 。 新车延续星越 L 的家族设计，通过大面积镀铬来营造豪华风格，长宽高分别为 4955/1960/1769mm，轴距达到 2900mm，车顶配备了激光雷达，支持千里浩瀚 H5 等高阶辅助驾驶功能。 新车座舱采用中控 + 副驾双联屏方案，形成 30 英寸一体式天际屏，并配有 17.3 英寸二排娱乐屏；车机搭载高通骁龙 8295 芯片、Flyme Auto 智能座舱，内置超级 Eva 智能体。 根据介绍，星越 L PLUS 将与星瑞 L PLUS 一同组成全新的旗舰智混产品系列。新车将提供燃油、油电混动（IT之家注：与插电混动不同，油电混动须上蓝牌）两种动力，搭载型号为 BHE20-EFZ 的发动机，排量为 1999 ml（从输出来看为 2.0T），发动机功率为 160 kW，最大扭矩 360N·m，驱动电机功率 230kW。 燃油版本车型搭载纯汽油动力系统，发动机型号为 BHE20-PFZ，排量同样为 1999 ml，发动机功率为 213 kW，最大净功率为 205 kW，最高车速可达 210 km/h。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: R 星北方工作室负责人尼尔森：《GTA 6》驾驶体验吸收了《GTA 4》和《GTA 5》各自的优点
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 5 日消息，《GTA 6》的车开起来究竟是什么感觉？据外媒 GamesRadar 今天（5 日）报道，R 星北方工作室负责人罗布 · 尼尔森表示，《GTA 6》的驾驶体验介于《GTA 4》和《GTA 5》两者之间，吸收了两款游戏各自的优点。 在被问及《GTA 6》的车辆是否会像《GTA 4》一样具有明显的“重量感”时，尼尔森表示：“有，但只保留了这种感觉 最好的一面 。团队花了很多精力，既保留《GTA 4》车辆重量感和驾驶感受中最出色的部分，又让操控拥有《GTA 5》那样的易上手性。整个系统都针对这套硬件从零打造，团队能够更细致地调校传动系统、轮胎、悬架和转向等部分， 并把这些因素全部纳入物理模型 。” 目前，除了 R 星和发行商 Take-Two 内部人员，还没有其他人真正上手体验过《GTA 6》，因此外界也没有对游戏各项机制形成客观、独立的实际体验评价。R 星负责人自然会宣称新作兼具《GTA 4》和《GTA 5》的优点，至于实际表现是否如此，只能等到 11 月见分晓。 IT之家注：《GTA 6》将于 11 月 19 日登陆 PS5 和 Xbox Series X。

observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 5 日消息，森海塞尔 MOMENTUM 真无线 5 代 蓝牙耳机今日首销，预估到手价为 2399 元。 IT之家从商品页面获悉，这款耳机采用 7mm 动圈驱动单元，支持无线无损传输，搭载骁龙畅听™技术，支持 aptX™ Lossless 编解码器，可以通过蓝牙实现 CD 品质（ 16 bit/44.1 kHz ）的无损音频传输，摆脱线材束缚同时保留高清音乐细节，还原人声器乐层次。 音效方面，它支持 杜比全景声空间音频 ，支持头部追踪技术，精准还原声音定位细节，打造专属 3D 空间声场，观影自带环绕音效，游戏也可听声辨位。 降噪方面，这款耳机采用 高性能混合自适应主动降噪 ，可以持续感知环境噪音并自动调节降噪表现，比如在嘈杂列车上会自动优化过滤纷扰，搭配全新柔软硅胶耳垫可实现更好密封；同时升级自适应抗风噪，可以有效阻挡自然风声，也支持自然通透模式，清晰传递环境声音。 通话方面，它采用 AI 降噪 + 骨传导传感器 实现高清通话，每侧耳机内置 4 个麦克风，包含 1 个骨传导语音传感器，可以捕捉身体振动信号，配合优化的 AI 智能算法从嘈杂环境中分离人声，带来清晰自然的通话效果。 佩戴设计方面，它基于大量耳道扫描研究成果，采用验证过的人体工学设计，优化加长耳机外形，贴合耳部低位结构，单只耳机重量仅约 7g，佩戴舒适度相比上一代产品明显提升，运动时也能稳固贴合。 续航方面，这款耳机单次续航可达 12 小时，搭配充电盒总续航长达 40 小时，满足全天候使用需求，聆听不中断。 连接方面，它升级 蓝牙 6.0 ，提供无缝稳定的连接，支持多点连接，可以在多个设备之间轻松切换；同时支持蓝牙 AURACAST™ 广播音频技术，可便捷分享音频，还能直接接收机场、车站的公共广播；搭载蓝牙 LE Audio 编解码器，拥有高效音频传输能力，降低传输功耗延长续航，同时支持低延迟游戏

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 比亚迪：超级智能体迪迪虾暨腾势 N8L 纯电上市发布会定档 9 月 14 日
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 5 日消息，比亚迪旗下腾势品牌今日宣布，超级智能体迪迪虾暨腾势 N8L 纯电上市发布会定档 9 月 14 日。 在今年 5 月底的比亚迪“敢为”智能化战略发布会上，比亚迪发布了超级智能体“迪迪虾”，实现全舱记忆，跨域互动，端云协同，快慢思考。比亚迪官方表示，随着 AI 大模型与整车智能深度融合，汽车正在从传统的功能型工具向具备主动服务能力的“智能体”演进。 “迪迪虾”的核心目标是让车辆具备更自然的人机交互、主动服务和复杂任务处理能力。比亚迪称，其全面升级了中央大脑与整车智能体的情感架构，使其能够围绕用户需求提供更具个性化的服务体验。 今年 6 月，“迪迪虾”确认将登陆腾势 N8L 闪充版，采用活人逻辑， 支持根据用户需求操控车辆、多步骤复杂指令理解并执行 。另外，“迪迪虾”还可以打通手机生态。 腾势 N8L 纯电版定位大六座安全豪华 SUV，搭载 208L 超大智能电动前备箱。关于这款新车的更多消息，感兴趣的朋友可以关注IT之家后续报道。

observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 5 日消息，9 月 4 日，长安汽车在科技生态大会上发布 全栈自研智能辅助驾驶方案“天枢领航” ，目前已覆盖高速 NCA、城市 NCA 和全场景泊车三大核心功能域。 据财联社今日消息，长安汽车管理层透露， 公司计划于明年在海外率先落地“天枢领航”的高速 NCA 方案 ，城市 NCA 会晚一些。 对于海外市场，公司也将建立算力中心， 在当地数据闭环 ，并依据法律法规进行相关智能驾驶辅助落地。 据IT之家此前报道，9 月 1 日， 长安汽车公布了 8 月的交付成绩单 ：8 月交付 21.88 万辆，其中 海外交付 9.24 万辆、同比增长 78.6%，官方称海外交付 连续 7 个月同比大涨 。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 捷豹路虎即将启动大裁员，消息称总数达 4000 人
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 5 日消息，据《泰晤士报》今天（5 日）报道，英国最大汽车制造商捷豹路虎汽车计划未来两年裁员 4000 人，以应对成本飙升、销量大幅下滑以及美国关税带来的压力。 当地时间周五晚些时候，消息称捷豹路虎已向员工发出预警，公司预计将在下周一公布裁员计划。 捷豹路虎向彭博社作出回应称，公司将启动自愿离职计划，目标是在未来两年节省约 17 亿英镑 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 154.46 亿元人民币） 。面对全球市场环境变化，捷豹路虎希望将盈亏平衡销量降至 30 万辆，同时精简业务。不过，捷豹路虎没有在声明中透露计划裁减的具体人数。 捷豹路虎在英国 拥有约 3.3 万名员工 ，由印度塔塔汽车乘用车有限公司控股。最近一个季度，公司营收下降近 10%，税前利润 大跌 69% 至 1.09 亿英镑 （现汇率约合 9.9 亿元人民币） 。 本月早些时候，捷豹路虎首款纯电动揽胜上市，售价 15.407 万英镑 （现汇率约合 140 万元人民币） ，是目前市场上价格最高的电动 SUV 之一，比对应的燃油车型贵近 5 万英镑 （现汇率约合 45.4 万元人民币） 。这样的定价也进一步拉大了纯电动揽胜与席卷英国市场的中国低价 SUV 之间的价格差距。 除成本和销量压力外，捷豹路虎还面临美国关税上升以及中国市场需求下滑的压力。去年，公司曾遭遇网络攻击，全球业务一度全面停摆。 关税环境以及中国电动汽车带来的竞争压力，同样困扰着其他欧洲汽车制造商。大众汽车集团监事会支持一项重组计划，其中包括再裁员 5 万人。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 极哲推出 ZIP PRO 三折叠便携投影仪：586g 重、1080P 60Hz，预售到手价 2899 元
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 5 日消息，极哲 ZIP PRO 三折叠便携投影仪现已开启预售， 到手价 2899 元 。 这款产品重 586g，折叠后厚度 44mm；采用三折叠结构设计，展开自带支架，无需额外支架即可使用，可投射 60-120 英寸画面，支持正投、竖投、吊投、背投等。 这款产品支持 1080P 60Hz，色域覆盖 85% NTSC，亮度最高 200lm；配备 2×2W 立体声喇叭，支持同时连接两个蓝牙耳机；支持 Switch、手机、平板、电脑等 Type-C 设备有线直连。 这款产品内置 10000mAh 容量电池，标准模式下续航可达 120 分钟，支持 65W PD 快充；自带 LCD 触摸屏，可显示电量、连接状态，支持 DIY 自定义 Emoji、动画屏保。 IT之家附产品参数如下： 京东 极哲 ZIP PRO 三折叠便携投影机 单机 2899 元 直达链接

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 鸿海单月营收再超 9000 亿元新台币，8 月同比增 51.98%
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 5 日消息，鸿海今日公布数据，2026 年 8 月营收为 9,218 亿元新台币 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1,955.14 亿元人民币） ，月减 2.61%，同比增长 51.98%， 为历年单月次高、同期新高 。继上个月后，鸿海单月营收再次超过 9,000 亿元新台币 （现汇率约合 1,908.9 亿元人民币） 门槛。 此外，鸿海 2026 年累计前 8 月营收为 6.5111 万亿元新台币 （现汇率约合 1.38 万亿元人民币） ，同比增长 39.73%， 为历年同期最高 。 IT之家查询获悉，鸿海 2026 财年上半年营业总收入 4.65 万亿新台币 （现汇率约合 9,862.65 亿元人民币） ，同比增长 35.17%。归母净利润 1,098.93 亿新台币 （现汇率约合 233.08 亿元人民币） ，同比增长 27.09%。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 远山智行发布国内首款轮足式导盲机器人，室外避障成功率不低于 96%
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 5 日消息，中国兵器工业集团杭州智元研究院旗下科技子品牌“远山智行”9 月 4 日正式发布 国内首款轮足式导盲机器人 ——“小远”智能灵动导盲犬 。 官方表示，“小远”是国内首个面向视障人群的轮足式导盲机器人。 产品采用独特的轮足复合构型，实现平地滑行与楼梯攀爬的切换 。 其核心功能涵盖智能避障、路线引导、语音交互、陪伴提醒、异常求助与远程协助等，能精准识别低垂树枝、工地脚手架等传统导盲设备难以感知的悬空障碍，并提前减速、绕行。产品兼顾静谧性与平稳性，运行噪音极低，避免对视障用户自身的听声辨位造成干扰。 “小远”支持室内及户外开放环境全自主导航，可完成路线规划、自主跟随、障碍规避与动态调整。 室内避障成功率不低于 99%，室外避障成功率不低于 96% 。 “小远”采用导盲犬造型，增强公共空间接受度。本体通过多种可靠性和稳定性测试，室外定位误差不超过 30cm；通过多种方式反馈用户；可自主识别并避让行人、车辆与障碍物，降低公共空间碰撞风险。 IT之家获悉，目前杭州智元研究院“远山智行”品牌已与多地残联达成战略合作， 杭州市西湖区率先开放城市道路、商圈、园区等公共场景 ，推动“小远”在地铁、商场等场景试点落地。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 全新一代智己 LS6 大五座 SUV 四色首秀，9 月 10 日预售
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 5 日消息，智己汽车今日带来全新一代智己 LS6 四款外观车色首秀，包括拉斐尔茶、集米银、穆夏绿、戈雅黑， 全国展车已陆续到店 。 全新一代智己 LS6 预售发布会定档 9 月 10 日， 定位“全线控大五座 SUV” ，该车宣称搭载下一代全线控底盘、下一代舒享座舱，号称“陆上 A320”。据介绍，该车是航空同源理念打造的家庭 SUV，率先进入航空级安全时代。全系标配 NEO 三电架构、全线控底盘、IM CLAW 智能体、超级头等舱。 IT之家注意到，目前在售的新一代智己 LS6 车型于去年 9 月上市，纯电版上市权益价 19.79 万元起，增程版上市权益价 20.29 万元起。 在售的新一代智己 LS6 定位超级大五座智能 SUV，首搭智己“恒星”超级增程，综合续航达 1500+km，还搭载了灵蜥数字底盘 2.0。内饰方面，该车搭载全新全场景数字座舱，配备旗舰级 MinLED 显示技术，同时还有 27.1 英寸 5K 驾舱屏、 15.6 英寸 3K 副驾娱乐屏、车载冰箱、氛围灯、全车四座通风加热按摩、小桌板、柔光美妆镜等配置。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 小米平板 9 Pro Max 首发澎湃 OS 4：一键生成脑图、至高支持 6 分屏
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 5 日消息，小米平板 9 Pro Max 将于 9 月 7 日 19 点发布，首发小米澎湃 OS 4。据官方预热，新品搭载的澎湃 OS 4 带来全新文件管理，来源有迹可循；全新文档阅读器，可手写批注；支持特殊字体导入，高级打印。 新品搭载 PC 级浏览器，专业插件协作，支持网页翻译、三方 AI 插件，支持标签页竖排、分组，深度适配 Top500 高频网站。 全新小米笔记支持一键生成脑图，支持语音速记，音频、图片导入，零散表达一键生成结构化脑图。 小米平板 9 Pro Max 带来多分屏模式，至高支持 6 分屏。双分屏，自由调节显示比例；三分屏，一屏三应用并行；六分屏，复杂任务，全景处理。 小米平板 9 Pro Max 号称“小米最强专业生产力平板”，首发玄戒 O3 AI 旗舰处理器，整机跑分 525 万，CPU 多核、GPU 跑分媲美搭载 M5 芯片平板。首发新一代 LPDDR6，内存带宽提速 48%，支持游戏超分插帧、视频后期 AI 抠图。 外观方面，小米平板 9 Pro Max 提供“浓郁酒红”配色，采用金属一体化机身设计，配备简约 Deco、跑道型设计、XRING 徽标，搭配同色悬浮键盘。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 特斯拉 Cybercab 在美投运，博主 MKBHD 差点输掉头发
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 5 日消息，2024 年 10 月，特斯拉在“We, Robot”活动上发布了 Optimus、Robovan 和 Cybercab。Cybercab 延续了 Cybertruck 的设计语言，再次展现特斯拉设想中的无人驾驶汽车形态，而且彻底取消了方向盘和踏板。 当时，马斯克给出了价格和量产时间表：Cybercab 面向消费者的售价预计低于 3 万美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 20.2 万元人民币） ，并将在 2027 年之前进入大规模生产。 马斯克同时承认，自己对时间表往往“有点乐观”，这番表态也让科技博主 MKBHD 决定打一个赌。 MKBHD 认定特斯拉无法按时兑现承诺，并表示， 如果特斯拉真的做到，他就会直播剃光头 。MKBHD 给出的具体条件是：特斯拉 必须在 2027 年之前，以 3 万美元 （现汇率约合 20.2 万元人民币） 的价格向消费者出售 Cybercab 。 Cybercab 亮相后，更多车辆信息陆续曝光。Cybercab 的续航里程预计约为 482 km，并将采用大型铸件降低成本，预计售价 仍不超过 3 万美元 （现汇率约合 20.2 万元人民币） 。今年 2 月，项目进度甚至一度呈现出领先原定计划的迹象，首辆 Cybercab 已经从特斯拉得州生产线下线。 得知新的 Cybercab 活动定于 9 月 3 日举行后，MKBHD 也承认自己有些紧张。好在这场活动与向消费者销售 Cybercab 无关，而是宣布将 Cybercab 加入特斯拉 Robotaxi 网络 ，并在现有地理围栏范围内投入运营。 MKBHD 的头发暂时算是保住了。他随后表示，Cybercab 或许走在了时代前面，预计未来 10 年自动驾驶汽车会逐渐进入主流。无论最终赌约结果如何，MKBHD 都计划在明年 1 月向癌症研究机构捐款。

observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 5 日消息，理想汽车今日宣布，新一代理想 MEGA 正式迎来全国首批交付。 理想汽车 第一产品线负责人汤靖亲临现场，为首批车主完成新车交付。 IT之家注意到，新一代理想 Mega Home 于 9 月 2 日发布，新车只提供一种配置，全国统一零售价 50.98 万元，现在下订可获赠灰白两色飞碟轮毂等配置，理想用户复购可获赠 270° 电动调光玻璃。 外观方面，理想 Mega Home 可选灰 / 银 / 熊猫白 / 紫晶灰 / 新大象灰 5 种车色。该车新车前、后包围增加晶辉饰条装饰，新增智能三色星环灯提升精致感，车身长宽高分别为 5355*1965*1850mm， 轴距 3300mm ，提供 2.6m 长的 Sweet Home 超大迎宾光毯。 内饰方面，新一代理想 Mega Home 搭载 29 英寸 OLED 6K 全景中控屏 ，二排带有 21 英寸 OLED 4K 移动屏。搭载高通骁龙 8797 智能座舱芯片，拥有 9.3.6 无瑕星环剧院音响系统。除此之外还带有 2 颗马赫 M100 芯片、4 个激光雷达，支持新一代马赫 VLA 司机大模型。此外，主副驾和第二排均配备零重力座椅。 动力方面，新车采用前后双电机配置。前电机最大功率 155kW，后电机 258kW，综合功率可达 413kW 。配备 108kWh 三元锂 5C 超充电池，CLTC 综合续航里程可达 710km，10 分钟充电 500km。 带有线控转向、后轮转向等功能 ，采用 800V 主动防倾魔毯底盘。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 小米 18 Fold 中折叠手机“暖金白”“黑色”配色官图公布，9 月 7 日发布
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 5 日消息，小米 18 Fold 中折叠手机将于 9 月 7 日 19 点在小米秋季旗舰新品发布会上发布。小米官方今日公布了新机“ 暖金白 ”“ 黑色 ”配色官图。 据介绍，小米 18 Fold“中折叠”手机采用极窄四等边 + 超椭圆大 R 角设计；后置跑道型 Deco + 侧边纯平包裹式中框。 综合IT之家此前报道，小米 18 Fold 首发搭载玄戒 O3 AI 旗舰 SoC 。官方预热称这款新机搭载新形态内屏，采用 √2:1 标准纸张比例，带来更大有效显示面积。 小米 18 Fold 搭载 5.38 英寸外屏 + 7.58 英寸内屏，内外一致采用“超级像素技术”、全 RGB 排列， 支持 4000nits 峰值亮度 ，30% APL 日常场景触发，内屏还配备 AR 膜。 新机配备徕卡 2 亿超清主摄（1/1.56″大底传感器）+ 徕卡 5000 万潜望长焦（3.5 倍光学变焦）+ 徕卡 5000 万超广角， 内置 6000mAh 小米金沙江电池 ，支持 67W 有线秒充 + 50W 无线秒充。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 小米平板 9 Pro Max 搭载 13.3 英寸屏幕，全功能 Type-C 直连可做电脑副屏、专业数位屏、游戏大屏
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 5 日消息，小米平板 9 Pro Max 将于 9 月 7 日 19 点在小米秋季旗舰新品发布会上发布。 官方今日对新品进行预热，宣布小米平板 9 Pro Max 搭载了一块 13.3 英寸高清原色屏，3.4K 分辨率；3:2 屏幕比例、适配 PC 级应用界面；峰值亮度 1000nits、ΔE≈0.47。 官方表示，小米平板 9 Pro Max 通过全功能 Type-C 直连，秒变各种显示器 ，可做电脑副屏、专业数位屏、游戏大屏。 小米平板 9 Pro Max 连接 PC，可变身数位屏，搭配小米焦点触控笔 Pro，与 TourBox 组合用，支持双手同时操作。 小米平板 9 Pro Max 连接掌机变身游戏大屏，支持立体声效，可连接 DP 1.2 及以上协议的游戏掌机。 据IT之家此前报道，小米平板 9 Pro Max 首发玄戒 O3 AI 旗舰处理器 ；并首发小米澎湃 OS 4，专为大屏生产力构建。

analysis.summaryZh: IT之家 9 月 5 日消息，小米平板 9 Pro Max 将于 9 月 7 日 19 点在小米秋季旗舰新品发布会上发布。 官方今日对新品进行预热，宣布小米平板 9 Pro Max 搭载了一块 13.3 英寸高清原色屏，3.4K 分辨率；3:2 屏幕比例、适配 PC 级应用界面；峰值亮度 1000nits、ΔE≈0.47。 官方表示，小米平板 9 Pro Max 通过全功能 Type-C 直连，秒变各种显示器 ，可做电脑副屏、专业数位屏、游戏大屏。 小米平板 9 Pro Max 连接 PC，可变身数位屏，搭配小米焦点触控笔 Pro，与 TourBox 组合用，支持双手同时操作。 小米平板 9 Pro Max 连接掌机变身游戏大屏，支持立体声效，可连接 DP 1.2 及以上协议的游戏掌机。 据IT之家此前报道，小米平板 9 Pro Max 首发玄戒 O3 AI 旗舰处理器 ；并首发小米澎湃 OS 4，专为大屏生产力构建。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 英伟达发布 616.86 热修复驱动：修复浏览器闪屏与远程桌面黑屏问题
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 5 日消息，英伟达今日发布了 616.86 版本 GeForce Hotfix 热修复驱动程序。该补丁基于最新的 Game Ready 616.64 版驱动，旨在解决部分用户升级驱动后遇到的三大问题： 浏览特定网站时，浏览器可能出现间歇性画面闪烁。 升级至 616.56 版驱动后，系统无法创建虚拟显示器。 升级至 616.56 版驱动后，远程桌面协议（RDP）会话可能显示黑屏。 英伟达表示，这些修复内容将会整合进未来的官方驱动版本中。本次发布的 616.86 版属于可选的热修复补丁，其质量保证流程相比常规 WHQL 驱动更短。 IT之家注：该驱动支持 Windows 10 和 Windows 11 的 64 位系统，支持 GeForce RTX 50/40/30 系列显卡。该热修复补丁不会通过 NVIDIA App 推送，需用户访问 NVIDIA 客户支持页面手动下载安装。另外，安装后 NVIDIA App 可能仍显示较旧的驱动版本日期，这属于正常现象，不代表安装失败。 https://international.download.nvidia.com/Windows/616.86hf/616.86-desktop-notebook-win10-win11-64bit-international-dch.h f.exe 相关阅读： 《 英伟达 616.56 WHQL 驱动程序存在闪屏问题，已在测试修复方案 》

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 启境 GX7 预售 18 小时小订突破 2 万台，24.99-31.19 万元
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 5 日消息，由广汽与华为联合打造的启境品牌官方今日宣布， 启境 GX7 预售 18 小时，小订突破 20,000 台 。 据IT之家此前报道， 启境 GX7 昨晚正式预售 ，新车定位中大型阔五座 SUV， 预售价 24.99-31.19 万元 。 增程 Ultra 版：预售价 24.99 万元 增程 Ultra 双电机版：预售价 26.99 万元 增程 Ultra 三电机版：预售价 31.19 万元 启境 GX7 车身尺寸为长 5099 mm、宽 2006 mm、高 1750 mm，轴距 3070 mm；有茶卡银、梅里白、贝加尔蓝、西湖烟紫、普罗旺斯紫、帕米尔黑六款车色可选。 启境 GX7 搭载 华为七大汽车智能化解决方案 ：包含华为乾崑智驾、鸿蒙座舱、华为乾崑赤兔平台、华为乾崑车载光、华为乾崑车云、华为鲸鳍通信、华为智擎电驱。 启境 GX7 首批搭载华为乾崑智驾 ADS 5，同级唯一 4 颗激光雷达，搭载 38 个高性能传感器（前向 14 个、后向 12 个、侧向 12 个）；也是鸿蒙座舱 6 首批搭载车型。 启境 GX7 全系标配宁德时代电池，提供 52kWh 和 67kWh 两种版本，CLTC 纯电续航里程 325-385km，CLTC 综合续航里程 1500-1580km。

events.titleEn: Driving Developer Excellence: Inside the Program Sprints
events.summaryZh: The Gemini Enterprise Developer Experience (DevEx) program conducts ongoing sprint testing of end-to-end developer workflows to identify and rapidly resolve friction points without relying on internal shortcuts. This recent sprint focused on optimizing enterprise AI governance, including refining setup prerequisites, securing extension configurations, and clarifying policy enforcement mechanics to ensure a smoother, more reliable deployment. events.titleZh: GPT-6 Astra 模型发布，OpenAI 总裁布罗克曼自信放话“欢迎来到 AGI 时代”
events.titleEn: GPT-6 Astra 模型发布，OpenAI 总裁布罗克曼自信放话“欢迎来到 AGI 时代”
events.summaryZh: IT之家 9 月 5 日消息，据《商业内幕》报道，OpenAI 宣布，新推出的 Astra 模型已经达到 AI 行业最为追求的一个里程碑。当地时间周四，OpenAI 总裁格雷格 · 布罗克曼在宣布 Astra 模型推出的媒体电话会议结束时自信喊话：“ 欢迎来到 AGI 时代 。” OpenAI 将 AGI 定义为 在大多数具有经济价值的工作中，表现超过人类的高度自主系统 。在其看来，Astra 是一项重大研究突破，意味着人们能够交给 AI 完成的工作范围发生了变化。 布罗克曼此前认为，实现 AGI 并非一个突然发生的时刻， 而是一个渐进过程 。而这次在新模型发布后，他是这样说的：“未来人们回过头看，可能会认为 AGI 大概就是在这个时候出现的，我认为可能就是 从这个模型开始的 。就我个人而言，我确实认为我们已经到了这个阶段。” GPT-6 Astra 距离 GPT-5 模型系列推出约一年，距离 OpenAI 最近一次推出 GPT-5.6 升级约两个月。OpenAI 称 Astra 是“全球最智能、对齐程度最高的模型”，并将其形容为专业工作的一次跃迁。 根据介绍，Astra 可以填写表格、调整文档格式、安排预约以及操作软件。“任何你能在电脑上完成的事情，Astra 都能替你完成，而且速度很快。” 其他科技行业领导者同样将 AGI 视为 AI 发展的重要目标。据IT之家了解，谷歌 DeepMind 联合创始人哈萨比斯在 5 月举行的公司大会上作出预测： AGI 最早将在 2030 年出现 ，人类正站在“奇点的山脚下”。

events.titleZh: 吉利星越 L PLUS 首发亮相：定位中大型旗舰智混 SUV，近期上市
events.titleEn: 吉利星越 L PLUS 首发亮相：定位中大型旗舰智混 SUV，近期上市
events.summaryZh: IT之家 9 月 5 日消息，吉利全新车型 —— 星越 L PLUS 今天（5 日）晚间正式亮相，新车尺寸比现款星越 L 更大，并运用双拼色、大饼轮毂来强调豪华、精致的气息，将于 近期正式上市 。 新车延续星越 L 的家族设计，通过大面积镀铬来营造豪华风格，长宽高分别为 4955/1960/1769mm，轴距达到 2900mm，车顶配备了激光雷达，支持千里浩瀚 H5 等高阶辅助驾驶功能。 新车座舱采用中控 + 副驾双联屏方案，形成 30 英寸一体式天际屏，并配有 17.3 英寸二排娱乐屏；车机搭载高通骁龙 8295 芯片、Flyme Auto 智能座舱，内置超级 Eva 智能体。 根据介绍，星越 L PLUS 将与星瑞 L PLUS 一同组成全新的旗舰智混产品系列。新车将提供燃油、油电混动（IT之家注：与插电混动不同，油电混动须上蓝牌）两种动力，搭载型号为 BHE20-EFZ 的发动机，排量为 1999 ml（从输出来看为 2.0T），发动机功率为 160 kW，最大扭矩 360N·m，驱动电机功率 230kW。 燃油版本车型搭载纯汽油动力系统，发动机型号为 BHE20-PFZ，排量同样为 1999 ml，发动机功率为 213 kW，最大净功率为 205 kW，最高车速可达 210 km/h。

events.titleZh: 特斯拉 Cybercab 在美投运，博主 MKBHD 差点输掉头发
events.titleEn: 特斯拉 Cybercab 在美投运，博主 MKBHD 差点输掉头发
events.summaryZh: IT之家 9 月 5 日消息，2024 年 10 月，特斯拉在“We, Robot”活动上发布了 Optimus、Robovan 和 Cybercab。Cybercab 延续了 Cybertruck 的设计语言，再次展现特斯拉设想中的无人驾驶汽车形态，而且彻底取消了方向盘和踏板。 当时，马斯克给出了价格和量产时间表：Cybercab 面向消费者的售价预计低于 3 万美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 20.2 万元人民币） ，并将在 2027 年之前进入大规模生产。 马斯克同时承认，自己对时间表往往“有点乐观”，这番表态也让科技博主 MKBHD 决定打一个赌。 MKBHD 认定特斯拉无法按时兑现承诺，并表示， 如果特斯拉真的做到，他就会直播剃光头 。MKBHD 给出的具体条件是：特斯拉 必须在 2027 年之前，以 3 万美元 （现汇率约合 20.2 万元人民币） 的价格向消费者出售 Cybercab 。 Cybercab 亮相后，更多车辆信息陆续曝光。Cybercab 的续航里程预计约为 482 km，并将采用大型铸件降低成本，预计售价 仍不超过 3 万美元 （现汇率约合 20.2 万元人民币） 。今年 2 月，项目进度甚至一度呈现出领先原定计划的迹象，首辆 Cybercab 已经从特斯拉得州生产线下线。 得知新的 Cybercab 活动定于 9 月 3 日举行后，MKBHD 也承认自己有些紧张。好在这场活动与向消费者销售 Cybercab 无关，而是宣布将 Cybercab 加入特斯拉 Robotaxi 网络 ，并在现有地理围栏范围内投入运营。 MKBHD 的头发暂时算是保住了。他随后表示，Cybercab 或许走在了时代前面，预计未来 10 年自动驾驶汽车会逐渐进入主流。无论最终赌约结果如何，MKBHD 都计划在明年 1 月向癌症研究机构捐款。

events.titleZh: 50.98 万元，新一代理想 MEGA 开启全国首批交付
events.titleEn: 50.98 万元，新一代理想 MEGA 开启全国首批交付
events.summaryZh: IT之家 9 月 5 日消息，理想汽车今日宣布，新一代理想 MEGA 正式迎来全国首批交付。 理想汽车 第一产品线负责人汤靖亲临现场，为首批车主完成新车交付。 IT之家注意到，新一代理想 Mega Home 于 9 月 2 日发布，新车只提供一种配置，全国统一零售价 50.98 万元，现在下订可获赠灰白两色飞碟轮毂等配置，理想用户复购可获赠 270° 电动调光玻璃。 外观方面，理想 Mega Home 可选灰 / 银 / 熊猫白 / 紫晶灰 / 新大象灰 5 种车色。该车新车前、后包围增加晶辉饰条装饰，新增智能三色星环灯提升精致感，车身长宽高分别为 5355*1965*1850mm， 轴距 3300mm ，提供 2.6m 长的 Sweet Home 超大迎宾光毯。 内饰方面，新一代理想 Mega Home 搭载 29 英寸 OLED 6K 全景中控屏 ，二排带有 21 英寸 OLED 4K 移动屏。搭载高通骁龙 8797 智能座舱芯片，拥有 9.3.6 无瑕星环剧院音响系统。除此之外还带有 2 颗马赫 M100 芯片、4 个激光雷达，支持新一代马赫 VLA 司机大模型。此外，主副驾和第二排均配备零重力座椅。 动力方面，新车采用前后双电机配置。前电机最大功率 155kW，后电机 258kW，综合功率可达 413kW 。配备 108kWh 三元锂 5C 超充电池，CLTC 综合续航里程可达 710km，10 分钟充电 500km。 带有线控转向、后轮转向等功能 ，采用 800V 主动防倾魔毯底盘。

events.titleZh: 小米 18 Fold 中折叠手机“暖金白”“黑色”配色官图公布，9 月 7 日发布
events.titleEn: 小米 18 Fold 中折叠手机“暖金白”“黑色”配色官图公布，9 月 7 日发布
events.summaryZh: IT之家 9 月 5 日消息，小米 18 Fold 中折叠手机将于 9 月 7 日 19 点在小米秋季旗舰新品发布会上发布。小米官方今日公布了新机“ 暖金白 ”“ 黑色 ”配色官图。 据介绍，小米 18 Fold“中折叠”手机采用极窄四等边 + 超椭圆大 R 角设计；后置跑道型 Deco + 侧边纯平包裹式中框。 综合IT之家此前报道，小米 18 Fold 首发搭载玄戒 O3 AI 旗舰 SoC 。官方预热称这款新机搭载新形态内屏，采用 √2:1 标准纸张比例，带来更大有效显示面积。 小米 18 Fold 搭载 5.38 英寸外屏 + 7.58 英寸内屏，内外一致采用“超级像素技术”、全 RGB 排列， 支持 4000nits 峰值亮度 ，30% APL 日常场景触发，内屏还配备 AR 膜。 新机配备徕卡 2 亿超清主摄（1/1.56″大底传感器）+ 徕卡 5000 万潜望长焦（3.5 倍光学变焦）+ 徕卡 5000 万超广角， 内置 6000mAh 小米金沙江电池 ，支持 67W 有线秒充 + 50W 无线秒充。

events.titleEn: 小米平板 9 Pro Max 搭载 13.3 英寸屏幕，全功能 Type-C 直连可做电脑副屏、专业数位屏、游戏大屏
events.summaryZh: IT之家 9 月 5 日消息，小米平板 9 Pro Max 将于 9 月 7 日 19 点在小米秋季旗舰新品发布会上发布。 官方今日对新品进行预热，宣布小米平板 9 Pro Max 搭载了一块 13.3 英寸高清原色屏，3.4K 分辨率；3:2 屏幕比例、适配 PC 级应用界面；峰值亮度 1000nits、ΔE≈0.47。 官方表示，小米平板 9 Pro Max 通过全功能 Type-C 直连，秒变各种显示器 ，可做电脑副屏、专业数位屏、游戏大屏。 小米平板 9 Pro Max 连接 PC，可变身数位屏，搭配小米焦点触控笔 Pro，与 TourBox 组合用，支持双手同时操作。 小米平板 9 Pro Max 连接掌机变身游戏大屏，支持立体声效，可连接 DP 1.2 及以上协议的游戏掌机。 据IT之家此前报道，小米平板 9 Pro Max 首发玄戒 O3 AI 旗舰处理器 ；并首发小米澎湃 OS 4，专为大屏生产力构建。

events.titleZh: 英伟达发布 616.86 热修复驱动：修复浏览器闪屏与远程桌面黑屏问题
events.titleEn: 英伟达发布 616.86 热修复驱动：修复浏览器闪屏与远程桌面黑屏问题
events.summaryZh: IT之家 9 月 5 日消息，英伟达今日发布了 616.86 版本 GeForce Hotfix 热修复驱动程序。该补丁基于最新的 Game Ready 616.64 版驱动，旨在解决部分用户升级驱动后遇到的三大问题： 浏览特定网站时，浏览器可能出现间歇性画面闪烁。 升级至 616.56 版驱动后，系统无法创建虚拟显示器。 升级至 616.56 版驱动后，远程桌面协议（RDP）会话可能显示黑屏。 英伟达表示，这些修复内容将会整合进未来的官方驱动版本中。本次发布的 616.86 版属于可选的热修复补丁，其质量保证流程相比常规 WHQL 驱动更短。 IT之家注：该驱动支持 Windows 10 和 Windows 11 的 64 位系统，支持 GeForce RTX 50/40/30 系列显卡。该热修复补丁不会通过 NVIDIA App 推送，需用户访问 NVIDIA 客户支持页面手动下载安装。另外，安装后 NVIDIA App 可能仍显示较旧的驱动版本日期，这属于正常现象，不代表安装失败。 https://international.download.nvidia.com/Windows/616.86hf/616.86-desktop-notebook-win10-win11-64bit-international-dch.h f.exe 相关阅读： 《 英伟达 616.56 WHQL 驱动程序存在闪屏问题，已在测试修复方案 》

events.summaryZh: IT之家 9 月 5 日消息，由广汽与华为联合打造的启境品牌官方今日宣布， 启境 GX7 预售 18 小时，小订突破 20,000 台 。 据IT之家此前报道， 启境 GX7 昨晚正式预售 ，新车定位中大型阔五座 SUV， 预售价 24.99-31.19 万元 。 增程 Ultra 版：预售价 24.99 万元 增程 Ultra 双电机版：预售价 26.99 万元 增程 Ultra 三电机版：预售价 31.19 万元 启境 GX7 车身尺寸为长 5099 mm、宽 2006 mm、高 1750 mm，轴距 3070 mm；有茶卡银、梅里白、贝加尔蓝、西湖烟紫、普罗旺斯紫、帕米尔黑六款车色可选。 启境 GX7 搭载 华为七大汽车智能化解决方案 ：包含华为乾崑智驾、鸿蒙座舱、华为乾崑赤兔平台、华为乾崑车载光、华为乾崑车云、华为鲸鳍通信、华为智擎电驱。 启境 GX7 首批搭载华为乾崑智驾 ADS 5，同级唯一 4 颗激光雷达，搭载 38 个高性能传感器（前向 14 个、后向 12 个、侧向 12 个）；也是鸿蒙座舱 6 首批搭载车型。 启境 GX7 全系标配宁德时代电池，提供 52kWh 和 67kWh 两种版本，CLTC 纯电续航里程 325-385km，CLTC 综合续航里程 1500-1580km。

events.titleZh: Video generation models as world simulators
events.titleEn: Video generation models as world simulators
events.summaryZh: We explore large-scale training of generative models on video data. Specifically, we train text-conditional diffusion models jointly on videos and images of variable durations, resolutions and aspect ratios. We leverage a transformer architecture that operates on spacetime patches of video and image latent codes. Our largest model, Sora, is capable of generating a minute of high fidelity video. Our results suggest that scaling video generation models is a promising path towards building general purpose simulators of the physical world.
events.summaryEn: We explore large-scale training of generative models on video data. Specifically, we train text-conditional diffusion models jointly on videos and images of variable durations, resolutions and aspect ratios. We leverage a transformer architecture that operates on spacetime patches of video and image latent codes. Our largest model, Sora, is capable of generating a minute of high fidelity video. Our results suggest that scaling video generation models is a promising path towards building general purpose simulators of the physical world.

events.titleZh: Building an early warning system for LLM-aided biological threat creation
events.titleEn: Building an early warning system for LLM-aided biological threat creation
events.summaryZh: We’re developing a blueprint for evaluating the risk that a large language model (LLM) could aid someone in creating a biological threat. In an evaluation involving both biology experts and students, we found that GPT-4 provides at most a mild uplift in biological threat creation accuracy. While this uplift is not large enough to be conclusive, our finding is a starting point for continued research and community deliberation.

events.titleZh: Forecasting potential misuses of language models for disinformation campaigns and how to reduce risk
events.titleEn: Forecasting potential misuses of language models for disinformation campaigns and how to reduce risk
events.summaryZh: OpenAI researchers collaborated with Georgetown University’s Center for Security and Emerging Technology and the Stanford Internet Observatory to investigate how large language models might be misused for disinformation purposes. The collaboration included an October 2021 workshop bringing together 30 disinformation researchers, machine learning experts, and policy analysts, and culminated in a co-authored report building on more than a year of research. This report outlines the threats that language models pose to the information environment if used to augment disinformation campaigns and introduces a framework for analyzing potential mitigations. Read the full report here.

events.titleZh: Improving verifiability in AI development
events.titleEn: Improving verifiability in AI development
events.summaryZh: We’ve contributed to a multi-stakeholder report by 58 co-authors at 30 organizations, including the Centre for the Future of Intelligence, Mila, Schwartz Reisman Institute for Technology and Society, Center for Advanced Study in the Behavioral Sciences, and Center for Security and Emerging Technologies. This report describes 10 mechanisms to improve the verifiability of claims made about AI systems. Developers can use these tools to provide evidence that AI systems are safe, secure, fair, or privacy-preserving. Users, policymakers, and civil society can use these tools to evaluate AI development processes.

events.titleZh: Fine-tuning GPT-2 from human preferences
events.titleEn: Fine-tuning GPT-2 from human preferences
events.summaryZh: We’ve fine-tuned the 774M parameter GPT-2 language model using human feedback for various tasks, successfully matching the preferences of the external human labelers, though those preferences did not always match our own. Specifically, for summarization tasks the labelers preferred sentences copied wholesale from the input (we’d only asked them to ensure accuracy), so our models learned to copy. Summarization required 60k human labels; simpler tasks which continue text in various styles required only 5k. Our motivation is to move safety techniques closer to the general task of “machines talking to humans,” which we believe is key to extracting information about human values.

events.titleZh: Emergent tool use from multi-agent interaction
events.titleEn: Emergent tool use from multi-agent interaction
events.summaryZh: We’ve observed agents discovering progressively more complex tool use while playing a simple game of hide-and-seek. Through training in our new simulated hide-and-seek environment, agents build a series of six distinct strategies and counterstrategies, some of which we did not know our environment supported. The self-supervised emergent complexity in this simple environment further suggests that multi-agent co-adaptation may one day produce extremely complex and intelligent behavior.

events.titleZh: Why responsible AI development needs cooperation on safety
events.titleEn: Why responsible AI development needs cooperation on safety
events.summaryZh: We’ve written a policy research paper identifying four strategies that can be used today to improve the likelihood of long-term industry cooperation on safety norms in AI: communicating risks and benefits, technical collaboration, increased transparency, and incentivizing standards. Our analysis shows that industry cooperation on safety will be instrumental in ensuring that AI systems are safe and beneficial, but competitive pressures could lead to a collective action problem, potentially causing AI companies to under-invest in safety. We hope these strategies will encourage greater cooperation on the safe development of AI and lead to better global outcomes of AI.

events.titleZh: AI safety needs social scientists
events.titleEn: AI safety needs social scientists
events.summaryZh: We’ve written a paper arguing that long-term AI safety research needs social scientists to ensure AI alignment algorithms succeed when actual humans are involved. Properly aligning advanced AI systems with human values requires resolving many uncertainties related to the psychology of human rationality, emotion, and biases. The aim of this paper is to spark further collaboration between machine learning and social science researchers, and we plan to hire social scientists to work on this full time at OpenAI.

events.titleZh: Quantifying generalization in reinforcement learning
events.titleEn: Quantifying generalization in reinforcement learning
events.summaryZh: We’re releasing CoinRun, a training environment which provides a metric for an agent’s ability to transfer its experience to novel situations and has already helped clarify a longstanding puzzle in reinforcement learning. CoinRun strikes a desirable balance in complexity: the environment is simpler than traditional platformer games like Sonic the Hedgehog but still poses a worthy generalization challenge for state of the art algorithms.

events.titleZh: Glow: Better reversible generative models
events.titleEn: Glow: Better reversible generative models
events.summaryZh: We introduce Glow, a reversible generative model which uses invertible 1x1 convolutions. It extends previous work on reversible generative models and simplifies the architecture. Our model can generate realistic high resolution images, supports efficient sampling, and discovers features that can be used to manipulate attributes of data. We’re releasing code for the model and an online visualization tool so people can explore and build on these results.

events.titleZh: Learning Montezuma’s Revenge from a single demonstration
events.titleEn: Learning Montezuma’s Revenge from a single demonstration
events.summaryZh: We’ve trained an agent to achieve a high score of 74,500 on Montezuma’s Revenge from a single human demonstration, better than any previously published result. Our algorithm is simple: the agent plays a sequence of games starting from carefully chosen states from the demonstration, and learns from them by optimizing the game score using PPO, the same reinforcement learning algorithm that underpins OpenAI Five.

Our algorithm is simple: the agent plays a sequence of games starting from carefully chosen states from the demonstration, and learns from them by optimizing the game score using PPO, the same reinforcement learning algorithm that underpins OpenAI Five.

events.titleZh: Improving language understanding with unsupervised learning
events.titleEn: Improving language understanding with unsupervised learning
events.summaryZh: We’ve obtained state-of-the-art results on a suite of diverse language tasks with a scalable, task-agnostic system, which we’re also releasing. Our approach is a combination of two existing ideas: transformers and unsupervised pre-training. These results provide a convincing example that pairing supervised learning methods with unsupervised pre-training works very well; this is an idea that many have explored in the past, and we hope our result motivates further research into applying this idea on larger and more diverse datasets.

events.titleZh: Evolved Policy Gradients
events.titleEn: Evolved Policy Gradients
events.summaryZh: We’re releasing an experimental metalearning approach called Evolved Policy Gradients, a method that evolves the loss function of learning agents, which can enable fast training on novel tasks. Agents trained with EPG can succeed at basic tasks at test time that were outside their training regime, like learning to navigate to an object on a different side of the room from where it was placed during training.

events.titleZh: Competitive self-play
events.titleEn: Competitive self-play
events.summaryZh: We’ve found that self-play allows simulated AIs to discover physical skills like tackling, ducking, faking, kicking, catching, and diving for the ball, without explicitly designing an environment with these skills in mind. Self-play ensures that the environment is always the right difficulty for an AI to improve. Taken alongside our Dota 2 self-play results, we have increasing confidence that self-play will be a core part of powerful AI systems in the future.

events.titleZh: OpenAI Baselines: ACKTR & A2C
events.titleEn: OpenAI Baselines: ACKTR & A2C
events.summaryZh: We’re releasing two new OpenAI Baselines implementations: ACKTR and A2C. A2C is a synchronous, deterministic variant of Asynchronous Advantage Actor Critic (A3C) which we’ve found gives equal performance. ACKTR is a more sample-efficient reinforcement learning algorithm than TRPO and A2C, and requires only slightly more computation than A2C per update.

events.summaryZh: We’ve created a bot which beats the world’s top professionals at 1v1 matches of Dota 2 under standard tournament rules. This is a step towards building AI systems which accomplish well-defined goals in messy, complicated situations involving real humans.

events.titleZh: Learning from human preferences
events.titleEn: Learning from human preferences
events.summaryZh: One step towards building safe AI systems is to remove the need for humans to write goal functions, since using a simple proxy for a complex goal, or getting the complex goal a bit wrong, can lead to undesirable and even dangerous behavior. In collaboration with DeepMind’s safety team, we’ve developed an algorithm which can infer what humans want by being told which of two proposed behaviors is better.

events.titleZh: Learning to cooperate, compete, and communicate
events.titleEn: Learning to cooperate, compete, and communicate
events.summaryZh: Multiagent environments where agents compete for resources are stepping stones on the path to AGI. Multiagent environments have two useful properties: first, there is a natural curriculum—the difficulty of the environment is determined by the skill of your competitors (and if you’re competing against clones of yourself, the environment exactly matches your skill level). Second, a multiagent environment has no stable equilibrium: no matter how smart an agent is, there’s always pressure to get smarter. These environments have a very different feel from traditional environments, and it’ll take a lot more research before we become good at them.
